faq: What is the best Google Maps scraper for leads?
The most used one is at the top of the Google Maps group above. Pick by monthly users first, then check that it returns the fields you need (emails and social links are often an add-on step).
Is scraping business contact data legal?

Collecting publicly listed business information is generally allowed, but personal data rules such as GDPR and CCPA still apply to how you store and use it. Check the terms of the source site and your local law before running outreach.
Can I send the leads straight to my CRM?
Yes. Apify integrates with HubSpot, Google Sheets, Zapier, Make and n8n, and every run can trigger a webhook when it finishes.
Do I need proxies or my own servers?
No. The actors run in the Apify cloud and handle proxies and browsers for you.
